name: codex-lane-supervisor
ramp: systemctl --user set-property --runtime lane-supervisor.service CPUQuota=$(( 2600 * FLEET_PERCENT / 100 > 100 ? 2600 * FLEET_PERCENT / 100 : 100 ))%
busy: cd $HOME/lane-supervisor && python3 supervisor.py status | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin)["running_lanes"]; print("running lanes: " + " ".join(r)); sys.exit(0 if r else 1)'
